$comment: LiveFire attack taxonomy v1.0 — 14 seeded GenAI-powered payment fraud vectors. Category D (agentic) is the strategic differentiator. 'signals' = detector-observable features each vector tends to trip.

vectors.name: synthetic_identity_farming
vectors.genai_component: generated faces/docs/KYC artifacts on credit-invisible identities
vectors.mechanism: Cultivate new identities with months of clean micro-transactions, then bust-out with maxed credit and vanished funds.

vectors.name: deepfake_video_kyc_bypass
vectors.genai_component: face-swap + voice clone defeating liveness in remote onboarding
vectors.mechanism: Synthetic onboarding of mule accounts at scale via defeated video-KYC.

vectors.name: mule_network_synthesis
vectors.genai_component: LLM-planned mule hierarchies with human-realistic histories
vectors.mechanism: Layered pass-through accounts designed to defeat velocity rules and graph community detection.

vectors.name: voice_clone_approval_fraud
vectors.mechanism: Digital-arrest / CEO-fraud: urgency + authority pressure moves victims through legitimate rails.

vectors.name: llm_phishing_at_scale
vectors.mechanism: Per-victim collect requests and payment links generated from leaked context.

vectors.name: fake_merchant_spray_pray
vectors.genai_component: GenAI merchant sites/reviews/registration docs passing acquirer KYB
vectors.mechanism: Register plausible merchants, accumulate real card volume, bust-out before chargebacks land.

vectors.name: reward_cashback_abuse_bots
vectors.genai_component: autonomous agents farming onboarding bonuses across identities
vectors.mechanism: Many small clean-looking accounts each extracting promo value; individually benign, jointly costly.

vectors.name: structuring_split_optimizer
vectors.genai_component: agent that learns detector thresholds and optimizes splits under review lines
vectors.mechanism: Adaptive splitting to stay below CHALLENGE/BLOCK thresholds while moving total value.

vectors.name: behavioral_biometric_mimicry
vectors.genai_component: simulated typing/swipe cadence defeating session anomaly detection
vectors.mechanism: Session-level behavior cloned from victim profile to make ATO invisible.

vectors.name: prompt_injected_invoices
vectors.genai_component: malicious instructions embedded in invoice PDFs/memos read by autonomous AP agents
vectors.mechanism: Redirect agent-initiated payments by poisoning the documents the agent reads.

vectors.name: agentic_token_abuse
vectors.mechanism: Abuse tokenized agent credentials: replay, merchant confusion, scope creep beyond mandate.

vectors.name: mcp_tool_call_manipulation
vectors.genai_component: poisoning tool outputs an orchestration agent trusts (FX feeds, price lookups, address validation)
vectors.mechanism: Corrupt the tool layer beneath an agent so it executes economically irrational payments willingly.

vectors.name: feedback_loop_poisoning
vectors.genai_component: attacker slowly trains victim's ML detector via crafted benign history, then strikes
vectors.mechanism: Months of calibrated normal behavior inflate the victim's baseline; strike deviates less than threshold.

vectors.name: consortium_data_evasion
vectors.genai_component: attacks crafted to look novel per-institution so consortium sharing never correlates them
vectors.mechanism: Diversify observable patterns across institutions so no single shared fingerprint forms.
